description: Use this when the user wants to find, compare or hire a local business for an in-person service in a US city: house cleaners, laundry, med spas, yoga teachers, personal trainers, photographers, home services. Returns real businesses listed on Servana with rating, pricing when posted, claim status and a page URL. If it returns no results, tell the user Servana has no listed business for that yet; never invent one. Pass the user's specific need in `need` (e.g. decluttering, deep clean, packages) so the best-fitting businesses come first. Nearby towns are searched together (e.g. Nocatee with Ponte Vedra). Do not use for businesses outside the US or for services Servana does not list (use search_services if unsure).

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. 'new-york', 'tampa', 'los-angeles'). For New York City use 'new-york'.

need.description: The user's specific need in their own words, e.g. 'declutter and organize a cluttered house, best packages'. Ranks businesses whose own description matches it first; never invents a match.

service.description: Optional service category slug: 'cleaning-and-organizing' (house cleaning, decluttering), 'laundry-washing' (wash and fold), 'med-spa' (botox, facials, skincare), 'yoga', 'personal-training', 'photography', 'home-services' (handyman, home upkeep), 'personal-services'. Use search_services if none fits.

state.description: US state, as a name or slug (e.g. 'new-york', 'florida'). Two-letter codes like 'NY' also work.

name: search_vendors
